reasoning_details.text: The user is asking for the number of work-hours equivalent to one estimated workday. This is a simple factual question about the convention I used. I stated in my assumptions that "A developer workday is 8 hours". So the answer is 8.

technical_and_design_decisions: Landing page (U1) will be implemented as a simple HTML/JSP view with navigation links; assume existing admin UI framework (e.g., Spring MVC + Thymeleaf or Angular-based dashboard) is available and extensible.

For U2, retryable exceptions will be configurable via the bus-level 'retryableExceptions' deployment property (list of fully-qualified class names) merged with per-stream overrides; kryo deserialization failures (org.springframework.amqp.support.converter.MessageConversionException and Kryo deserialization errors) will be added to a default non-retryable set.
U3-U5 are dependency upgrade tasks; approach is to bump the version in the parent POM, resolve any compile/test failures from breaking changes, and re-run the full test suite.

For U6, module id and container id will be exposed to components via existing module deployment properties (xd.module.id, xd.container.id) populated by the runtime module deployer; a helper/utility class will be provided so components can read them from the environment for log enrichment (e.g., MDC).

For U7, Kafka bus producer/consumer properties (autoCommitEnabled, queueSize, maxWait, fetchSize, batchSize, batchTimeout) will be exposed as module-level deployment properties that override the bus defaults; this reuses the existing bus property override mechanism.
U8 is purely a repository reorganization: move/consolidate the Ambari RPM build scripts into the same public git repository as the main XD RPM scripts, and update README/CI references.
assumptions: One senior developer familiar with Spring XD, Spring Integration, Spring AMQP, Spring Kafka, and Spring Hadoop performs all work.
The Spring XD codebase is already checked out and buildable locally; environment setup is not part of the estimate.
Estimates exclude requirements gathering, product management coordination, and code review overhead (developer performs the work themselves).
For U2, the underlying Spring AMQP retry interceptor allows custom non-retryable exception classes; no upstream Spring AMQP changes are required.
Upgrades in U3, U4, and U5 are minor-compatible within their respective families and do not require significant API refactoring of XD code.
No new third-party libraries beyond the version upgrades are introduced.
A developer workday is 8 hours; estimates below are in whole or fractional workdays.
Integration testing focuses on the changed areas; full end-to-end regression of all transports is not in scope.

activities.activity_description: Review all eight user stories, inspect relevant parts of the Spring XD codebase (admin UI, RabbitMessageBus, KafkaMessageBus, runtime module deployer, RPM scripts), and produce a short design note covering the approach for each story.

activities.activity_name: Implement landing page with higher-order links (U1)
activities.activity_description: Add a new landing/index view to the XD admin UI exposing top-level links to the Sources, Processors, Sinks, and Jobs sections, and wire it as the default entry page.

Extend RabbitMessageBus so the set of retryable exceptions is configurable at bus and stream deployment property level; ensure AMQP MessageConversionException and Kryo deserialization errors are excluded from retries by default. Update property binding, bus options metadata, and tests.
Bump the Spring Integration dependency to 4.1.5.RELEASE in the parent and module POMs, fix any compile or test breakage caused by the upgrade, and verify the relevant message channel code paths.

activities.activity_name: Upgrade Spring Integration Kafka extension to 1.2.0 (U4)
activities.activity_description: Bump the SI Kafka extension dependency to 1.2.0, adjust any configuration or API call sites in the Kafka bus to match, and run the Kafka test suite.
Bump the Spring Hadoop dependency to 2.2.0.GA, fix compile/test breakage, and verify Hadoop-backed jobs and batch components still work.

activities.activity_name: Expose module id and container id to components (U6)
activities.activity_description: Populate xd.module.id and xd.container.id as module deployment properties during deployment, provide a small utility/lookup helper, and document usage so that source/processor/sink modules can include the ids in their log statements (e.g., via MDC).

activities.activity_name: Override Kafka bus defaults per module (U7)
activities.activity_description: Add module-level deployment properties for Kafka consumers (autoCommitEnabled, queueSize, maxWait, fetchSize) and producers (batchSize, batchTimeout) that override the corresponding bus defaults, and wire them into the Kafka message bus factory.

activities.activity_name: Consolidate XD and Ambari RPM scripts into a single public repo (U8)
activities.activity_description: Move/merge the XD + Ambari RPM build scripts into the same public source repository, reorganize the directory layout, and update README and CI references so users have a single location for the build scripts.

Run integration tests covering the landing page navigation, Rabbit retry behavior with custom and kryo exceptions, upgraded SI/Kafka/Hadoop versions, module-id logging, Kafka bus property overrides, and verify the consolidated RPM scripts build.

Update the reference documentation to describe the landing page, the new Rabbit retryable-exception properties, the module/container id properties, the Kafka per-module override properties, the new dependency versions, and the consolidated RPM scripts location.
